scopePolicy: Participant projections, feedback and correction decisions remain owner- and scope-scoped; internal clinical identities are not published.

invariants.name: ordered-owner-scoped-journey
invariants.assertion: The first incomplete curriculum module determines the next action and later activities cannot bypass a pending baseline, remediation, correction or retention state.

invariants.name: non-punitive-assessment-runtime
invariants.assertion: Incomplete or human-review states do not receive an invented result or punitive global score.

invariants.name: independent-appeal-transition
invariants.assertion: Appeals require an independent reviewer, a valid decision transition and a versioned state history.

invariants.name: immutable-human-correction
invariants.assertion: Human correction appends a new result version, preserves the original attempt facts, emits metadata-only audit/event data and replays idempotently.

evidence.criterion: ordered journey, pause/resume, remediation and retention
evidence.command: pnpm exec vitest run packages/application/src/journey-use-cases.test.ts packages/persistence/src/journey-repository.test.ts packages/contracts/src/journey.test.ts --project unit
evidence.ownerScope: participant identity and requested scope ids are checked at application and persistence boundaries
evidence.teardown: in-memory fixtures are discarded after the test process

evidence.criterion: assessment result, remediation and retention do not fabricate mastery
evidence.ownerScope: participant-facing projections contain only the public result contract
evidence.teardown: synthetic states remain in process memory and are discarded after the test process

evidence.criterion: feedback, appeal, independent review and safe public projection
evidence.command: pnpm exec vitest run packages/domain/src/learning-state.test.ts packages/domain/src/appeal.test.ts packages/application/src/feedback-use-cases.test.ts packages/contracts/src/learning-state.test.ts --project unit
evidence.ownerScope: participant creation and staff transitions require the declared scope and server-side capability
evidence.teardown: synthetic ticket and appeal states are discarded after the test process

evidence.criterion: human correction, append-only result version and idempotent replay
evidence.command: pnpm exec vitest run packages/application/src/correction-use-cases.test.ts packages/persistence/src/correction-repository.test.ts packages/contracts/src/correction.test.ts --project unit
evidence.ownerScope: clinical correction capability is checked server-side and persistence writes use a transaction boundary
evidence.teardown: synthetic correction records are discarded after the test process
